cell_coordinates.endpoint_policy: Each cell derives q<=r1, q>r1, or split from outward intervals; a caller cannot select the arm.
cell_coordinates.q_policy: Each integer q block must lie wholly below the outward lower endpoint of ((y/K)^(1/3))/6; otherwise replay requires a split.
cell_coordinates.parity_policy: Even and odd q are separate lanes. Each lane exactly recomputes max(q/phi(q)) over its integer roster.
